answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150462 Country: india Title: Can you please explain the name AYANA and AYAT girls name meaning Question: Can you please explain the name AYANA and AYAT girls name meaning and please to explain this is right or not and what is the best name? Answer ID: 150462 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 969/942/L=7/1438) Ayana, apparently seems ambiguous word; hence it should not be kept. Ayat means sign, the sign of Allah’s power etc, in itself this name is good but better you choose any name among the names of the holy wives, holy daughters, or Sahabiyat, for example, Khadijah, Hafsah, Zainab, Ruqayya, Kulsum, Fatimah, Khansa, Barirah, Habibah etc for your daughter. These are good names. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
